name: Keldon Twilight
description: Event in Keld in 4205 AR where the dead rose under Phyrexian necromancy.

description_citations.text: "Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian necromancy raises the Keldon honored dead during the battle on the frozen lake.
timeline.quote: In the heat of battle, the Keldon honored dead were raised from their graves not by Twilight, but by Phyrexian necromancy.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golden Argosy carries surviving Keldons to Urborg for the final battle against Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: The Argosy then bore them off to Urborg where they fought in the final battle of the Invasion against Yawgmoth and his forces.

pages_say.description: The prophesied return of Keld's honored dead, who instead sided with the Phyrexians.
